items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: The line-up was Jimmy McPartland, Bud Freeman, on tenor, and on piano we had -- who was playing drums -- George Wettling was playing drums, Dick Cary and we had Milt Hinton.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Kansas also. Then Red played his thing and I understand right now, this taping right now, he's in Europe, in Paris. That's nice. That's great. He's doing fine. I talked to Mrs. Richards and had them over to the house and, anyway, following the frolics in Columbus I came back and low and behold, in between, back to the Stuyvesant and Central Plaza the Metropole Cafe on 48th and Broadway had changed its policy to jazz and I was one of the first bands that opened that place into jazz. The line-up was Jimmy…
Was he called the Judge then, did he have that nickname at that time, The Judge?
